messages:
Eve: quick request  need a compact launch asset pack for next Wed's benchmark webinar + inbound routing. Deliverables: hero slide (16:9), 3 benchmark tiles (latency / cost / throughput) with per-region sparklines, social GIF (1080 square, 3s), two email headers (600x200, 1200x300), and a 1-slide sales summary PPTX. Also need EN/FR/DE/JP locales and a small export manifest. Deadline: Tue EOD for drafts, Wed AM final. Who can take exports?

Tom: I can own exports + naming. couple clarifications: do tiles show percent primary + raw numbers small footnote? and do we need co-brand muted variants?

Eve: percent primary, raw numbers tiny below. yes include a muted co-brand palette and a grayscale print fallback. add a data-source line under tiles. avoid "fastest" language.

Ana: design taking this. i'll create master components in figma and include alt-text suggestions. will run color-contrast checks. timeline: sketches Mon, drafts Tue.

DesignBot: figma file created -> https://redwood.app/figma/launch-pack-3400001234 (components: hero, bench-tile, gif-timeline, email-headers). export tokens preloaded (PNG@2x, SVG, GIF, PPTX).

Ishaan: localization: i can do FR/DE/JP. please provide copy CSV with keys, context, and an alt-text column. also confirm whether to localize number formats (yes for FR/DE/JP).

SalesOps: slide needs editable fields: customer name, 30-40 char takeaway, and a 1-line plain-text snippet (140 chars) for CRM. Include two CTA flavors for A/B: "Register" and "See the numbers".

Tom: export naming convention proposal (review):
bench_latency_EN_v1.svg
bench_latency_EN_v1_cobrand.svg
hero_EN_v1_1920x1080.png
social_gif_EN_v1_1080.gif
email_header_EN_600x200_v1.png
sales_slide_EN_v1.PPTX
I'll append locale suffix for translations and _grayscale for print.

LegalOps: legal flag: avoid absolute claims, use approx sign (~) or ranges, and include data-source footnote. no competitor names. I need final copy 48h before external.

Ana: adding export presets: PNG@2x for hero/social, SVG for tiles, GIF 30fps max 3s, PPTX master with editable text boxes. i'll include alt-text in figma notes and a readme with filenames + one-liners.

Tom: small export snippet for ops team:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/figma/export
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIGMA_TOKEN"
  -d '{"file":"launch-pack-3400001234","formats":["png@2x","svg","gif","pptx"]}'
```

and a manifest CSV will live in figma comments.

Ishaan: i'll prepare translations once i get the keyed CSV. will return localized assets Tue evening. note: use localized number separators and add units (ms / $ per 1M tokens) in parentheses.

SalesOps: also request a plain-text subject line variants (2) and a 1-line elevator pitch for inbound routing.

Eve: great. Ana, drop the figma link + first drafts in this thread when ready and i'll route to product, sales, and legal for fast review. If any blocker, ping me immediately. :raised_hands:
